description: Dynamic weather-based advisory rules. rainfall_probability_percent is 0-100, rainfall_mm is forecast accumulation.

temperature_rules.advice: High temperature stress expected ({temperature}°C). Increase irrigation frequency and consider shade nets for sensitive crops.
Low temperature alert ({temperature}°C). Risk of cold stress/frost damage; consider protective covering for young plants.
Temperature is within the favorable range ({temperature}°C) for normal crop growth.

rainfall_rules.advice: High chance of rainfall ({rainfall_probability}% probability, {rainfall_mm}mm expected). Delay fertilizer and pesticide application to avoid runoff and wastage.
Moderate chance of rainfall ({rainfall_probability}% probability). Monitor conditions before applying fertilizer or irrigating.
Low chance of rainfall. Proceed with planned irrigation and field operations as scheduled.

combined_rules.heavy_rain_and_high_temp_gap: Sudden temperature drop after rainfall can stress crops; monitor for fungal disease risk due to high humidity following rain.
